ledger_evolution.strategy: Keep 67-entry v1 bytes immutable. Append a versioned delta using identical 21-field record schema and five-origin evidence structures; append composed index referencing base+delta. Do not label historical v1 runtime state as current.
ledger_evolution.rule_id: Never recycle an existing rule ID; first additions may start arc2-comparison-068, with explicit registry mapping. A comparison count is not a distinct learned principle count.
required_21_fields: HDSが実際に学習した要素
ledger_evolution.evidence: Each claim cites source commit/blob or pre-publication content SHA256, path, JSON Pointer and Unicode span or code line span. No data fill by inference. Not-recorded and explicit-negative stay separate.
ledger_evolution.guard_origin: New guard/wrapper/acceptance proof belongs to 新規実装 unless concrete evidence establishes another origin; fit bool alone is not a learned parameter.

attempt_record_required: previous accepted code and score artifact hashes
all finite hypothesis definition and no-pruning justification

failure_record_required: stage and task/example audit identity (never runtime routing)
input provenance and allowed exposure stage
failure_scope: Persist rejected attempts as well as adopted changes. Stage statuses may be not_run; never translate not_run into pass. Final no-answer and timeout/resource failure are separate axes.

regressions by test and prior correct grid
new failures and observed LM deficits
metrics.counting: Define partial_task as 0<correct_examples<test_count. wrong_attempted_tasks from legacy scorer includes partials and must not substitute for wrong_grid. Define reuse denominator before reporting rate; tasks and examples remain distinct. Always compare both last accepted and frozen60.

gate.candidate: previous correct grids identical AND wrong grids=0 AND no resource-failure increase AND all teachers reproduced AND query input-only AND information separation maintained AND all regressions PASS
gate.speedup: All outputs, HOLD statuses and reasons, all regressions and evidence identical; measured speed improvement under same resources. Only mathematically exact avoidance of redundant work. No heuristic/top-k pruning or timeout reduction.
gate.parallel: Read-only disjoint teacher shards and independent test processes; same HDS only sequential; one candidate integration and one canonical write at a time.
gate.stop: 120 complete and all artifact gates OR evidenced dominant limit of current route. No vNext development or core/authority modification.

caveats: Public evaluation development is not hidden/generalization measurement.
Existing runner separation is a data-flow contract, not an OS filesystem sandbox; do not overstate.
